msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia nurban-crew-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a grey and brown tartan oversized blazer with a black studded leather crossbody bag and wide dark jeans from the reference, walking at the Plaza de España in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain, with palm trees and the sea, on a sunny day, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia nurban-crew-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a dark brown leather biker jacket over an olive knit top from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia nurban-crew-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a rust-brown draped cowl-neck long-sleeved top from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia nurban-crew-36.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown, olive and cream argyle knit jumper over a white shirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia nurban-crew-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pink knit jumper with a white shirt collar and blue straight jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia nurban-crew-32.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing a table of neatly folded trousers and knitwear in olive, rust, cream and striped colours from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, referencia nurban-crew-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a bright small boutique with white walls, a grey table with folded knitwear and jeans, rails of clothes and a light wooden floor, no people, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
